comments.body:
Correct English name for this discovery: Capela do Fundador

Quest name: Wishes and Burdens (Chrono Quest - 4th period, 15th Century)
Quest location: Genoa Adventurers' Guild
Skill requirement: r8 Recognition, r10 Theology, PRT(Portuguese)
Pre-requisite discovery: Longbow of Aljubarrota discovery (from "Investigation of the Great King" quest) + Sword of the Prince of Portugal discovery (from "The End of a Vow" quest)
